``` ### css ```css .section-1 { width: 100%; height: 100vh; background: linear-gradient( rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3) ), url(../images/bg.jpg) center no-repeat; background-size: cover; flex-direction: column; } .section1-heading { font-size: 6rem; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; background-color: #e41c6f; padding: 0.3rem 2rem; margin-bottom: 5rem; letter-spacing: 1rem; text-transform: uppercase; border-bottom: 0.3rem solid #fff; text-shadow: 0.2rem 0.2rem 1rem #555; transform: skew(-10deg); } .section1-img { width: 28rem; border: #e41c6f solid 0.3rem; border-radius: 50%; } .section1-name { margin-top: 5rem; padding: 0.3rem 4rem; font-size: 2.5rem; color: #fff; transform: skew(-10deg); background-color: #e41c6f; } .section1-btn { margin-top: 5rem; color: black; background-color: #fff; font-size: 2rem; padding: 0.2rem 1rem; border: solid black 0.3rem; text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.2rem; } ``` ### border-box: 기울이기 ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/99497b73108215436bc42461f5c43d0cf09ba224/posts/1c3eda9b-0fe1-81d3-aa6d-c2e6da9e6df9/278d4c0a6963df8b.webp) ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/99497b73108215436bc42461f5c43d0cf09ba224/posts/1c3eda9b-0fe1-81d3-aa6d-c2e6da9e6df9/17bb90de31da9f07.webp) ```css transform: skew(-10deg); ``` ## Section - navbar ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/99497b73108215436bc42461f5c43d0cf09ba224/posts/1c3eda9b-0fe1-81d3-aa6d-c2e6da9e6df9/caea2042a43d8bfa.webp) - [ 100vh ]scroll 후 상단 fixed ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/99497b73108215436bc42461f5c43d0cf09ba224/posts/1c3eda9b-0fe1-81d3-aa6d-c2e6da9e6df9/b8ca98520ae5f64a.webp) ### html ```html

} .navbar-link { font-size: 1.7rem; font-weight: 600; color: #333; margin: 0 3rem; letter-spacing: 0.3rem; text-transform: uppercase; transition: color 0.2s; position: relative; } .navbar-link:hover { color: #fff; } .navbar-link::before { content: ""; width: 0; height: 0.2rem; background-color: #fff; position: absolute; right: -15%; bottom: -0.3rem; transition: width 0.2s; } .change.navbar-link { color: #fff; } .change.navbar-link::before { width: 130%; } .navbar-link:hover::before { width: 130%; } ``` ### js ```javascript const navbar = document.querySelector(".navbar"); const navbarOffsetTop = navbar.offsetTop; const sections = document.querySelectorAll("section"); const navbarLinks = document.querySelectorAll(".navbar-link"); const progress = document.querySelector(".progress-bars-wrapper"); const progressBarPercents = [97, 89, 85, 87, 80, 70, 50]; window.addEventListener("scroll", () => { mainFn(); }); const mainFn = () => { if (window.pageYOffset >= navbarOffsetTop) { navbar.classList.add("sticky"); } else { navbar.classList.remove("sticky"); } sections.forEach((section, i) => { if (window.pageYOffset >= section.offsetTop - 10) { navbarLinks.forEach((navbarLink) => { navbarLink.classList.remove("change"); }); navbarLinks[i].classList.add("change"); } }); if (window.pageYOffset + window.innerHeight >= progress.offsetTop) { document.querySelectorAll(".progress-percent").forEach((el, i) => { el.style.width = `${progressBarPercents[i]}%`; el.previousElementSibling.firstElementChild.textContent = progressBarPercents[i]; }); } }; mainFn(); window.addEventListener("resize", () => { window.location.reload(); }); ``` ## Section 2 - graph bars ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/99497b73108215436bc42461f5c43d0cf09ba224/posts/1c3eda9b-0fe1-81d3-aa6d-c2e6da9e6df9/18130b5438ecada1.webp) ### html ```html
